description.narrative: The PDO is to support an efficient green transformation for industrial firms in Turkiye.

The project aims to support industrial exporters to align with new requirements in export markets (e.g., CBAM, the green deal, the circular economy action plan, EU product directives), connected to their value chains, develop opportunities for extended green products, and support industrial firms in the adaptation to climate change impacts and adoption of relevant mitigation solutions. The project will support industrial firms to use resources more efficiently and innovate in their management, production process, and/or products to meet future market demands. The project will leverage the existing expertise and mechanism of key relevant organizations – under the umbrella of Ministry of Industry and Technology (MoIT)- in the implementation of the project. The project will have three borrowers: (a) The SME Development Organization of Turkiye (KOSGEB), guaranteed by the Ministry of Treasury and Finance (MoTF); (b) Scientific and Technological Research Council of Turkey (TÜBITAK), guaranteed by MoTF; and (c) MoTF for the benefit of MoIT. The project will be structured around four components, as follows: Component 1: Support industrial SMEs improve their resource performance and reduce their carbon emissions (US$250 million), which will be managed by KOSGEB. It will provide reimbursable financing for investments in solar energy, resource efficiency, and circular economy. Component 2: A Contingent Emergency Response component (CERC, US$0) to be implemented by KOSGEB in the event of an eligible crisis or emergency, in line with World Bank Policy: Investment Project Financing, paragraphs 12 and 13.Component 3: Support the Green Innovation of Industrial Enterprises (US$175 million), which will be managed by TÜBITAK. It will provide technology extension matching grants and reimbursable financing for green firm-level and platform-level innovation (product and process).Component 4: Project management and institutional development (US$25 million), which will be managed by DGI-MOIT and aims to coordinate project activities, define an eligible green technology taxonomy, provide technical assistance to MOIT and partners, qualify and certify green transformation experts, establish a green knowledge management system for industries, and provide awareness to firms about the project's activities and results.The project is consistent with FY18-21 Country Partnership Framework (CPF) for Turkey, which was recently extended through the Program and Learning Review. Specifically, the Project is well aligned with the CPF's Focus Areas 1 (Growth) and 3 (Sustainability) and would support the following CPF objectives: (a) CPF Objective 3: Enhanced Competitiveness and Employment in Selected Industries; (b) CPF Objective 7: Improved reliability of energy supply and generation of green energy. The project is fully aligned with the Bank's Country Climate and Development Reports (CCDR) recommendation to adopt a resilient and net zero pathway that can help Turkiye achieve its development and climate objectives but implies a significant departure from current trends and important policy changes.

condition.narrative: KOSGEB LA, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (a) and (b). KOSGEB shall, throughout the implementation of the KOSGEB's Respective Part ofthe Project, operationalize and maintain a PIU, with terms of reference, staffing and budgetary resources necessary and appropriateto effectively carry out KOSGEB's Respective Part of the Project and ensure the PIU satisfactorily carries out itsresponsibilities.

KOSGEB LA, Schedule 2, Section I.B.1 and 2. KOSGEB shall maintain, throughout the implementation of KOSGEB's Respective Part ofthe Project, the POM, in substance and manner acceptable to the Bank, and shall carry out KOSGEB's Respective Part of the Project,and cause said Part of the Project to be carried out, in accordance with the arrangements, procedures and guidelines set forth inthe POM.

KOSGEB LA, Schedule 2, Section I.C.1. To ensure the proper implementation of contingent emergency response activities under Part 2of the Project (“Contingent Emergency Response Component”), the Borrower shall ensure that: (a) a manual (“CERC Manual”) isprepared and adopted which shall set forth detailed implementation arrangements for the Contingent Emergency Response Component;(b) the Emergency Action Plan is prepared and adopted; (b) the Emergency Response Component is carried out in accordance with theCERC Manual and the Emergency Action Plan.

KOSGEB LA, Schedule 2, Section I.C.1. In carrying out Parts 1.A and 1.B of the Project, KOSGEB shall extend KOSGEB ReimbursableFinancing for the financing of eligible activities (a) to SMEs that qualify in accordance with the eligibility and selectioncriteria for beneficiary SMEs and proposed Subprojects, (b) on terms and conditions for KOSGEB's provision of KOSGEB ReimbursableFinancing to beneficiary SMEs, and (c) in accordance with the procedures for approving KOSGEB Reimbursable Financing andSubprojects, acceptable to the Bank.
KOSGEB LA, Schedule 2, Section I.E.2. KOSGEB shall ensure that KOSGEB's Respective Part of the Project is implemented inaccordance with the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan.

KOSGEB LA, Schedule 2, Section I.F.1 (a) and (b). KOSGEB shall prepare and furnish to the Bank not later than December 15th ofeach year during the implementation of KOSGEB's Respective Part of the Project, a proposed Annual Work Plan and Budget, and affordthe Bank a reasonable opportunity to exchange views, and shall thereafter ensure that KOSGEB's Respective Part of the Project isimplemented with due diligence during said following year, in accordance with such Annual Work Plan and Budget.

Republic of Türkiye Loan Agreement (RoT LA), Schedule 2, Section I.A.1. The Borrower, through MoIT, shall operationalize andmaintain a Project Implementation Unit (PIU), with terms of reference, staffing and budgetary resources necessary and appropriateto effectively carry out Borrower's Respective Part of the Project, and ensure the PIU satisfactorily carries out itsresponsibilities.

RoT LA, Schedule 2, Section I.B.1 and 2. The Borrower, through MoIT, shall maintain the Project Operations Manual (POM) and shallcarry out the Borrower's Respective Part of the Project, and cause the said Part of the Project to be carried out, in accordancewith the arrangements, procedures and guidelines set forth in the POM.

RoT LA, Schedule 2, Section I.C.2. The Borrower, through MoIT, shall ensure that the Borrower's Respective Part of the Project isimplemented in accordance with the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan.

RoT LA, Schedule 2, Section I.D.1(a) and (b). The Borrower, through MoIT, shall prepare and furnish to the Bank not later thanDecember 15th of each year a proposed Annual Work Plan and Budget, and afford the Bank a reasonable opportunity to exchange views,and shall thereafter ensure that the Borrower's Respective Part of the Project is implemented with due diligence during saidfollowing year, in accordance with such Annual Work Plan and Budget.

TÜBİTAK LA, Schedule 2, Section I.A.1 (a) and (b). TÜBİTAK shall, throughout the implementation of the TÜBİTAK's Respective Partof the Project, operationalize and maintain a PIU, with terms of reference, staffing and budgetary resources necessary andappropriate to effectively carry out TÜBİTAK's Respective Part of the Project and ensure the PIU satisfactorily carries out itsresponsibilities.

TÜBİTAK LA, Schedule 2, Section I.B.1 and 2. TÜBİTAK shall maintain, throughout the implementation of TÜBİTAK's Respective Part ofthe Project, the POM, in substance and manner acceptable to the Bank, and shall carry out TÜBİTAK's Respective Part of the Project,and cause said Part of the Project to be carried out, in accordance with the arrangements, procedures and guidelines set forth inthe POM.

TÜBİTAK LA, Schedule 2, Section I.C.1. In carrying out Parts 3.A, 3.B, and 3.C of the Project, TÜBİTAK shall extend TÜBİTAKReimbursable Financing and Matching Grants for the financing of eligible activities (a) to firms that qualify in accordance withthe eligibility and selection criteria for beneficiary SMEs and Large Firms and proposed Subprojects, (b) on terms and conditionsfor the Borrower's provision of TÜBİTAK Reimbursable Financing and Matching Grants to beneficiary SMEs and Large Firms, and (c) inaccordance with the procedures for approving TÜBİTAK Reimbursable Financing and Matching Grants and Subprojects, acceptable to theBank.
TÜBİTAK LA, Schedule 2, Section I.D.2. TÜBİTAK shall ensure that TÜBİTAK's Respective Part of the Project is implemented inaccordance with the Environmental and Social Commitment Plan.

TÜBİTAK LA, Schedule 2, Section I.E.1 (a) and (b). TÜBİTAK shall prepare and furnish to the Bank not later than December 31st ofeach year during the implementation of TÜBİTAK's Respective Part of the Project, a proposed Annual Work Plan and Budget, and affordthe Bank a reasonable opportunity to exchange views, and shall thereafter ensure that TÜBİTAK's Respective Part of the Project isimplemented with due diligence during said following year, in accordance with such Annual Work Plan and Budget.
